tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: All measured parameters are within normal limits except for a mildly decreased total carbon dioxide, which may suggest mild metabolic acidosis or compensated respiratory alkalosis. Correlation with clinical findings and, if indicated, further acid-base assessment is recommended. No other significant laboratory abnormalities detected.
